info.name: Kamino Public Airdrop Lookup Tables API

items.docs: Finds the smallest set of Lookup Table (LUT) addresses that together cover all the provided Solana addresses. Optionally verifies active LUTs on-chain.

info.name: Get managed LUTs for a product

params.name: productIdentifierAddress
params.description: The product identifier address to look up LUTs for

items.docs: Returns active lookup table addresses associated with a given product identifier address.

info.name: Get managed LUTs for multiple products

params.name: productIdentifierAddress
params.description: One or more product identifier addresses

items.docs: Returns active lookup table addresses for multiple product identifier addresses in a single request.

info.name: Get managed LUTs by product type

params.name: productType
params.description: The type of product associated with a managed lookup table

items.docs: Returns all active lookup table addresses grouped by product for a given product type.

info.name: Register a new vault with its on-chain LUT

items.docs: Verifies the vault and LUT exist on-chain, then registers the vault product and LUT entry. Private (authorized) API access only, please add a basic auth header to your request.
